notes: §2002:14.8.6.1 (rendered PDF p450): CLOSE {file-name-1 [{REEL|UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] | WITH {NO REWIND|LOCK}]}..., WITH and FOR optional. A single CLOSE that writes all four alternatives (with UNIT REMOVAL written without FOR), plus CLOSE f LOCK and CLOSE f NO REWIND written without WITH, is accepted and runs at --std 2002 (MULTI=07 07 07 00, as derived).
